Location: @UUID[JournalEntry.YD0Td8Y9aJyIpGSl]{Helen Ward's Apartment}
Scenes: @UUID[JournalEntry.w9xeQJg6psfiMjFU.JournalEntryPage.yyXMKcpDOIhGuZIB]{A0-E01 · The Call from SAFE} · @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.T8gJWjZpOnL4OisP]{A1-E01 · What They Took} · @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.7brn5AgmWggUl420]{A3-E01 · The Other Son}

Arrival (A0-E01, 3:34 a.m.). The street door on Market Street is open; the common stairway climbs along the front of the building and comes out in the third-floor hallway, right beside the door of 3A. It smells of damp, wet wool, and coins (a ghoul's watered-down Vitae, P-02: Resolve + Awareness Diff. 2, or Auspex 1). Helen is sitting on the floor of the entryway, hood up, facing the door, counting under her breath.

The cameras (P-01). All four doors on the hallway have a Gale Sentinel doorbell camera with its little blue light (“led-timbre” lights). The one on 3B, across from Helen's, is the only one aimed at her door, and it also has a blinking green light: it's streaming live (Wits + Awareness Diff. 3). Helen's keeps the disconnection log from 2:52 to 3:03 a.m. (Intelligence + Technology Diff. 3). Smashing the 3B camera: Thermometer +1; opening it up and disconnecting it: Dexterity + Larceny Diff. 3. Leaving through the hallway without dealing with it: ANOMALY tags each Kindred as a “cold subject” (Thermometer +1).

The door of 3A. It wasn't forced: someone opened it with an electronic pick and locked it again with a single turn (the handle was left level, not drooping). The outside handle carries the ghoul's Vitae (P-02; Auspex 4, Spirit's Touch). With 3 or more successes on Intelligence + Investigation (A1-E01), a tiny black sticker turns up on the frame: the repeater that knocked out the cameras. It isn't drawn on the map and has no tile: it's the reward for the roll.

Study. Walls covered in maps with red pins (deaths), blue (disappearances), and yellow. On the desk, against the north wall, the open laptop with the audio paused (tile; Intelligence + Technology Diff. 4: the cloud was wiped from an IP at an Eastside data center, part of P-06) and the frayed cable hanging there, plugged into nothing: that's where the drive was. In the right-hand drawer, the flip phone with a single number, SAFE (DOC-05). On the east wall, the built-in closet, whose door sticks halfway and creaks (door with the “woodCreaky” sound): at the back was the shoebox with the second copy; it's gone. Only the closet and the desk were opened. The sash window on the west wall opens onto the fire escape; Helen's ashtray is outside, on the grating.

Living room and kitchen. The TV is still on its cabinet and the jar of bills is still on the counter: nothing worth money was taken. The kitchen table is the one from A3-E01 if Krell arrives late: overturned chair, a phone with a cracked screen on the floor, and, on the table, the paper held down by a shell casing. The window onto Market Street is the only lit window on the third floor (floor lamp).

Escaping without the 3B camera. Through the study window to the fire escape, and from there to the service alley (Dexterity + Stealth Diff. 2 so nobody in the building sees them climb down). On the fire escape, the “Down” region leads to the foot of the ladder in the alley and the “Up” one brings them back; the drop ladder has to be lowered from above or reached with a jump from the alley. The alley comes out onto Market Street to the south.

The roof landing. Beside the flight going down, another flight goes up to a landing with the roof door (locked; there's no map of the roof). That's where Helen hid, behind the railing, where the hallway light doesn't reach; from the hallway, the ghoul raised his head toward it and sniffed.

Off the map. Bear waits in the van on Market Street; half a block down there's a gray electric car with someone inside (MEN-04, leaves at 4:10 a.m. if nobody does anything). In A3-E01, Krell waits on the sidewalk across the street.

Apartments 3B, 3C, and 3D belong to the neighbors: furnished, dark, and locked (their doors, locked). At 3:34 a.m. they're asleep; the book only says that someone in the building might see the coterie climbing down the fire escape. The windows of 3C face the service alley. If someone forces a door, the Storyteller handles it: the book doesn't cover it.

The movable furniture (9) are unlocked tiles: they can be moved, knocked over or used as a barricade.

Placed tokens. Hidden ones are revealed from the token layer; the ones that depend on how the night went say when.
